title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ‘Realising the Triple Nexus approach in Somalia through complementary area-based Disaster Risk Management, Early Warning and Livelihoods’ project in Ainabo and Garowe districts of Sool and Nugal regions in Somalia, implemented by Oxfam through ICSP will reach 34,800 people directly especially women and youth from pastoralist and agro-pastoralist communities affected by frequent droughts and high levels of food insecurity, conflict and gender inequalities. Oxfam will partner with Candlelight in Somaliland and directly implement in Puntland to support the communities’ needs across the three main thematic areas 1) water, 2) sustainable livelihoods and 3) peace building. This project outcome focuses on restoring community infrastructure using soil and water conservation, rangeland, construction, and upgrading of multi-use structures. This is a critical intervention under this impact area of the programme and would have not been funded if this intervention was not implemented.
